subject.title: fix(infra): converge legacy state migrations on archive collisions

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's convergence policy for already-imported legacy sources and unresolved Codex binding sidecars before merge?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes upgrade-time persisted-state cleanup and warning severity, which is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision even with focused tests and real-state proof.

options.title: Accept With Exact-Head Proof
options.body: Proceed once the branch is refreshed if needed and exact-head CI confirms the reviewed migration behavior.

options.title: Require Broader Upgrade Replay
options.body: Ask for a packaged gateway plus doctor replay artifact on a copied state directory before merge if maintainers want stronger release proof.

options.title: Narrow The Notice Policy
options.body: Keep unresolved-owner Codex sidecars as warning blockers if maintainers decide retained sidecars must not be allowed through startup.

recommendation.title: Accept With Exact-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed once the branch is refreshed if needed and exact-head CI confirms the reviewed migration behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current policy implementation and has prior adjacent migration history, making them the best first owner for the merge-risk call.
